description: Exploit throughput along the batch axis. On the tip E024 (128/256/704, 50% of steps at 24 px with antialias, translate 2, LS 0.1, alternating flip, batch 1536, fused foreach SGD+Lookahead, 11 epochs), change only the batch size, from 1536 to 2048. Hold the per-example LR and wd fixed (per-step LR x4/3), tie the warmup/decay and Lookahead schedule to the new step count, recapture the CUDA graphs for both resolutions in build, and handle the last partial batch the same way as now.
